confidence_notes: I based the restaurant meal and cappuccino anchors on web searches of aggregated cost-of-living sites (traveltables, livingcost and similar). Those sites put an inexpensive meal at about USD 3.5-5, a mid-range meal for two at about USD 25-31 and a cappuccino at about USD 2.6-3. Draft beer is listed at about USD 1.6-2.1 in those indexes. I raised the beer anchor to about USD 3 because a standard serving in a restaurant usually costs more than the index figure. I had no good direct data for cocktails or wine, so I estimated them from typical Taiwan bar prices relative to beer; treat them as less certain. Accommodation anchors are general-knowledge model estimates only. I did not check any booking sites or listings. They do not account for possible July 2026 seasonal swings.
comparable_city_reasoning: I used Taichung and Tainan as comparisons. Both are second-tier Taiwanese cities with similar food prices, and all three are clearly cheaper than Taipei, especially for accommodation and cafes.
